description:
This image displays a screenshot of the CLC+ (CORINE Land Cover Plus) Core web application user interface, specifically the data catalogue for selecting Input Classes for data extraction. The browser URL visible is `https://clcplus-core.land.copernicus.eu/datacatalogue/extraction/...`.

The left panel, titled "Filter", shows several filtering options. Active filters include "Country: European Union (27)" and "Reference Year: 2018". A filter for "EAGLE Elements" is also applied, showing "Herbaceous Vegetation (Grass-Like, Fo...)". Other filter categories are "Region", "Time range", "100% EAGLE Compliant" (a toggle switch), and "INSPIRE Themes". A button to "CLEAR ALL FILTERS" is present at the bottom.

The main content area displays a table of Input Classes with the following columns: "EAGLE Approved" (checkboxes for selection), "Name", "Ingestion", "Created By", "Created At", "Reference Year", "EAGLE Elements", and "100% EAGLE Compliant" (checkboxes indicating compliance).

The visible table rows list various agricultural and natural land cover types: "dry pulses", "fodder crops", "grasslands", "other non pe...", "other root cr...", "Potatos", "Rape and tur...", "soya", "Sugar beet", and "sunflower". For all these entries, "Eurocrop" is listed under "Ingestion", "User Admin/Supp..." under "Created By", "24.12.2022" under "Created At", and "2018" under "Reference Year". All entries have the "100% EAGLE Compliant" checkbox checked.

A tooltip is active, displaying the "EAGLE Elements" associated with the "fodder crops" input class. It lists "10 elements": "Bare Soils (2)", "Herbaceous Vegetation (Grass-Like, Forbs, Ferns) (2)", "Commercial Crop Production (5)", "Production for Own Consumption (5)", "Perennial Plant (5)", "Arable Crop Land (5)", "Kitchen Garden (1)", "Alimentary Crop Production (1)", "Kitchen Gardens (1)", and "Dried Pulses and Protein Crops for The Production of Grain (5)". For other visible rows like "dry pulses" and "grasslands", the "EAGLE Elements" column shows "Bare Soils" followed by a "+9" icon, indicating 9 additional elements.

The table footer shows "Items per page: 10" and indicates that "1 – 10 of 11" items are currently displayed, with pagination controls available. The system tray shows the current time "20:17" and date "16.12.2023".
